ValidationRule.description: This validation rule ensures that Sales agreement status cannot be manually changed to Pending with Customer.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c), ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Pending with Customer'), NOT(ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_ApprovalStatus__c , 'Approved')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Sales Agreement must be approved internally prior to sending to customer, therefore this SA cannot be created/updated with the status of "Pending with Customer"
